thread:
zoe: heads-up - several customers reported SAML logins that immediately lose entitlements (admin/editor) after SSO. Looks like assertion accepted but downstream RBAC lookup returns empty. Anyone seen this pattern with our saml-assertion pipeline? :confused:

harrison: curious if this is an AssertionConsumerService (ACS) mismatch or something in the claim-mapper that decrypts the assertion extId. Any SCIM flows affected?

mina: quick check - a bunch of SCIM create events followed by immediate deprovision for the same externalIds from tenant `globex-corp`. Logs show `CreateUser` then `DeactivateUser` within seconds.

karthik: can you paste the relevant request traces (redacted)?

mina: paste (sanitized):
```
POST /saml/acs?RelayState=... 200 OK
Assertion: subject=urn:globex:john.doe attributes=[email,role=admin,externalId=\"ek:ENCRYPTED:...\"]
trace_id=tr-9f3
---
SCIM POST /scim/v2/Users -> 201 {id:u-211}
SCIM PATCH /scim/v2/Users/u-211 -> 403 {"error":"decrypt failed"}
SCIM PATCH /scim/v2/Users/u-211 -> 204 {"active":false}
```

zoe: that `ENCRYPTED` blob is our KMS-wrapped extId. If decrypt fails the provisioner marks user invalid and deprovs. Any KMS noise around the time?

kms-bot: kms:Decrypt errors spike count=18 window=5851234520..5851234565 error_types=[NotFound, AccessDenied] key_arn=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/abcd-rotated-key

harrison: NotFound + AccessDenied together suggests a key alias was moved/rotated and the new key either doesn't have policy access for our service or the old key id is missing. Did we have a key rotation running?

mina: ops notes show alias rotation at 5851234505 by key-ops pipeline. There was a shorter-than-usual overlap.

zoe: also note: SAML assertion acceptance used the extId in the assertion to map to RBAC before SCIM finish. If mapping fails due to decrypt error, we drop roles and still create local user record -> flip-flop. We should never drop roles until decrypt retries exhausted.

karthik: agreed. Immediate mitigation: (1) treat KMS NotFound/AccessDenied as transient during rotation and retry decrypt with exponential backoff for 10s; (2) change provisioner to hold on to asserted roles for session duration until SCIM finishes reconciliation.

harrison: ops patch idea: add `preflight` step to rotation that confirms key policy includes `service-role` and `provisioner-principal` before updating alias. Rotation job should fail-fast if policy check fails.

mina: running a quick staging repro - disabling alias swap and replaying assertions. If we can reproduce, we can test retry logic.

kms-bot: audit:rotation job=key-ops pipeline id=rot-5851234505 status=completed actor=automation user=key-ops precheck=skipped

zoe: oh precheck skipped. That's the gap. Put ops on it. Also need an audit trail addition: include `key_id` and `key_policy_snapshot` (or at least principals list) in rotation and in decrypt audit events so compliance can tie which key caused a missing entitlement. Right now logs only show alias.

karthik: I'll open a short PR to: (A) make decrypt exceptions map to 503 for SCIM callers on NotFound/AccessDenied so IdP side will retry, (B) add key_id & key_policy snapshot to provisioner audit events, (C) hold roles until SCIM finishes reconciliation or a longer timeout.

harrison: I'll update the key-ops rotation job to add a policy membership check and require a 30s overlap (old key remains accessible) when swapping alias. Also add canary decrypt as the `provisioner-principal` before marking success.

mina: staging repro shows that with retries enabled the flip rate drops to zero. With old behavior repro shows ~20% of assertions lost roles. Good signal.

zoe: action items recap:
1) karthik: PR to map KMS decrypt failures -> 503 + add key_id to audit + hold roles (PR + tests)
2) harrison: change rotation job to require policy precheck + overlap + canary decrypt
3) ops: run a one-off backfill to reconcile any users created then deactivated in the 5851234500..5851234600 window and notify affected tenants
4) compliance: add rotation audit requirement to include key_policy snapshot and key_id in ticket notes (assign to sec-compliance)

karthik: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/provisioner/pulls/519 - includes retry/backoff, audit changes, and session-hold for roles. Tests included.

mina: ran backfill script on staging - fixed 12 users on globex-corp. Ops will schedule a customer communication draft for impacted tenants.

zoe: filing ENGSEC-6122 for the incident and postmortem. Thanks team. If anyone sees related 403s or missing roles ping channel. :white_check_mark:
